270.DSCR:
The eldest daughter of Professor $$早乙女$$.
After the Ruunar War, she devoted herself to research on $$ゲッター線$$ together with her father.
An active woman, she sometimes even boarded Getter Robo as a pilot.
During combination training for Getter Liger aboard the Poseidon, she lost her life, crushed between the Liger and the Dragon.
But the truth behind the accident was that it had been a means of laying to rest herself, who had been parasitized by an $$インベーダー#robot$$. Even after her death, she appeared in the form she had in life before $$竜馬$$ and $$隼人$$, who were racked with guilt over having killed $$ミチル$$ in the nightmare world created by the $$インベーダー#robot$$s, and saved them.

271.DSCR:
A member of the Getter Team.
His stout build and hard stare give a rough, violent impression, but he actually loves children and is kind at heart.
In the Ruunar War as well, he was the key figure who brought victory to humanity through his teamwork with $$竜馬$$ and $$隼人$$.
After the Getter Team disbanded, he took $$元気$$ under his care and joined the Japanese military. But once the $$インベーダー#robot$$s he had thought he had wiped out in the Ruunar War appeared again, he entrusted $$元気$$ to $$弁慶$$ and rejoined $$竜馬$$ and the others. Boarding Getter-3 alone, he fought the $$インベーダー#robot$$s.
In the confusion of the melee he succeeded in protecting Professor $$早乙女$$, but a huge number of $$インベーダー#robot$$s drawn to the professor took control of his machine, and he was killed in action when the attack of $$ゴール＆ブライ$$ struck his cockpit.

272.DSCR:
Chief researcher at the $$ゲッター線$$ research institute of the $$国際機密連合$$.
He was formerly involved in the development of Getter Robo together with $$早乙女$$ and $$敷島$$.
Always acting alongside $$スティンガー$$, the two call each other by name with the suffix '-kun'.
$$コーウェン$$ was parasitized on the Moon by the parent $$インベーダー#robot$$ and worked behind the scenes to make the Earth the property of the $$インベーダー#robot$$s. In the decisive battle at Jupiter, $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$ fused together with a giant $$インベーダー#robot$$ and stood in the way of $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ and $$真ゲッター$$.

proofread.reason: pro-drop: the Japanese is a full sentence whose subject (the entry's own person, Cowen, male) was dropped; subject restored

273.DSCR:
Chief researcher at the $$ゲッター線$$ research institute of the $$国際機密連合$$.
He was formerly involved in the development of Getter Robo together with $$早乙女$$ and $$敷島$$.
Always acting alongside $$コーウェン$$, the two call each other by name with the suffix '-kun'.
$$スティンガー$$ was parasitized on the Moon by the parent $$インベーダー#robot$$ and worked behind the scenes to make the Earth the property of the $$インベーダー#robot$$s. In the decisive battle at Jupiter, $$スティンガー$$ and $$コーウェン$$ fused together with a giant $$インベーダー#robot$$ and stood in the way of $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ and $$真ゲッター$$.

proofread.reason: pro-drop: the Japanese is a full sentence whose subject (the entry's own person, Stinger, male) was dropped; subject restored

274.DSCR:
The form revealed when $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$ fused and showed their true nature as $$インベーダー#robot$$s.
It emerged from Jupiter, which had turned into a Getter sun.
Besides spewing out countless giant $$インベーダー#robot$$s, it made use of the moons Io, Callisto, and Europa to fire intense beams, driving $$竜馬$$ and the others into a corner.
In the end, it was cut in two, moons and all, by the Final Getter Tomahawk that combined the power of $$真ゲッター$$ and $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$.

275.DSCR:
The pilot of $$マジンガーＺ$$.
An ordinary high school student aiming to become a motorcycle racer, he was entrusted with the Hover Pilder and $$マジンガーＺ$$ by his grandfather $$十蔵$$, and fought against $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$.
He has a bright, easygoing temperament and is good at cooking. But he is also considerably tough with his fists, and is rumored in some circles to be the shadow boss of Atami.
He is also extremely devoted to his family, treasuring his younger brother $$シロー$$ and revering his grandfather $$十蔵$$. He flies into a rage and becomes unstoppable if he hears anyone speak ill of his grandfather.
After meeting $$錦織つばさ$$, he comes to make his home at $$くろがね屋$$.
At first he relied entirely on $$マジンガーＺ$$'s power and fought in a self-centered way. But through special training at $$くろがね屋$$ and fighting alongside $$さやか$$ and the Mazinger Corps, he grows both as a person and as a pilot.
When he fights Donau Alpha 1, he learns that $$つばさ$$ is his mother, and that she killed his father $$剣造$$, and he leaves $$くろがね屋$$ together with $$シロー$$. He then takes shelter at the Photon Power Institute and keeps his distance from $$つばさ$$, but when he fights $$ケドラ$$ he catches a glimpse of $$つばさ$$'s past and learns the truth of the matter, finally reconciling with her.
In the final battle, he swears to defeat $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$ and joins hands with his old enemy $$あしゅら男爵$$.
He defeats $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$, but can only stand frozen in shock at the unforeseen, worst-case turn of events that follows.

280.DSCR:
$$甲児$$'s younger brother.
An energetic, cheerful elementary school student whose motto is not to think too deeply about anything.
Though he adores his grandfather $$十蔵$$, his childish bluntness often gets the better of him, and he frequently cracks jokes like calling his grandfather's face scary, for which $$甲児$$ would scold him each time.
Meeting the mysterious girl $$ローレライ$$ drew him into the secrets of the Kabuto family, and for a time he joined $$甲児$$ in rejecting their mother $$つばさ$$. However, when $$つばさ$$ grew weak under Pygman's curse, he served as her bodyguard on $$甲児$$'s orders and was eventually able to reconcile with her.

proofread.reason: mistranslation (tense of events): the Japanese narrates past events (触れ ... 否定していた); 'draws' is present while the rest of the sentence is past

285.DSCR:
Proprietress of the $$くろがね屋$$, a hot spring inn in Atami.
A mysterious figure who commands the eccentric Kurogane Five and runs the $$くろがね屋$$.
She once served as an assistant to $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$ as a biologist, and accompanied him on the survey of $$バードス島$$. There she met $$兜剣造$$, whom she later married, and the two had $$甲児$$ and $$シロー$$ together. Before marrying $$剣造$$, she had also once been engaged to Stroheim Heinrich, an authority on robotics just like $$剣造$$.
While surveying $$バードス島$$, she noticed $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$'s scheme and tried to stop it together with $$十蔵$$ and the others, but the attempt failed when she was betrayed by $$剣造$$, whose body had been taken over by $$ケドラ$$. Even so, she managed to escape and waited for a chance to strike back.
Once $$マジンガーＺ$$, the trump card against $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$, passed into $$甲児$$'s hands, she supported him in many ways, helping him grow.
In the final battle, upon learning that her husband $$剣造$$, whom she had once believed she had killed, was still alive, she infiltrated enemy territory carrying a photon bomb, intending to finish him off for good this time. However, $$剣造$$ had regained his sanity, and hearing the truth from him, she learned of the fatal mistake she had made.

288.DSCR:
One of the Kurogane Five.
A swordmaster whose real name is unknown, he can cleave through anything with his Japanese sword made of Chogokin Z.
He seems to be skilled with blades of all kinds, and his knife work is second to none. Normally he plies his trade as the head chef of the $$くろがね屋$$.
He takes great pride in his work as a chef, and there was even a moment when he showed open anger after $$ガミアＱ$$ and the others ruined one of his dishes.

291.DSCR:
A blonde, blue-eyed girl, daughter of Stroheim Heinrich.
She suddenly appeared at the $$くろがね屋$$ one day and grew close to $$シロー$$.
Her true identity is the brain of Donau Alpha 1, and her becoming friends with $$シロー$$ was orchestrated by Stroheim, who was trying to teach her the emotion of sadness.
However, Stroheim died trying to reclaim Donau Alpha 1 after it was seized by $$あしゅら男爵$$. Upon losing her beloved father, $$ローレライ$$ came to know the emotion of sadness, and pulled out the ribbon on her head, the device that let her merge, becoming one with Donau Alpha 1. She then went into battle to fulfill her father's wish of defeating $$マジンガーＺ$$.
She fought $$マジンガーＺ$$ on more than equal terms, but was ultimately defeated. As $$シロー$$'s anguished cries echoed around her, the broken machinery of Donau kept sounding on, sad and mournful, as if it were $$ローレライ$$'s own song.

292.DSCR:
The father of $$甲児$$ and $$シロー$$, and a world-renowned authority on robotics.
He was supposed to have died on $$バードス島$$ at the hands of his wife, $$錦織つばさ$$, but appeared before $$甲児$$ and the others in various forms.
The $$剣造$$ who appeared riding $$エネルガーＺ$$ was $$ブロッケン$$ in disguise, but the true $$剣造$$ had survived, unknown to anyone.
In the midst of the final battle, $$剣造$$, reunited with $$つばさ$$, told her $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$'s true objective, but it was already too late, and the worst possible situation came to befall the world.

293.DSCR:
An Ultra Gorgeous Computer that $$十蔵$$ left behind to help $$甲児$$ in his hour of need.
His personality is exactly that of $$十蔵$$. He awakened the moment $$ゴッドスクランダー$$ was activated, appearing as a three-dimensional image small enough to sit neatly near the main console in the cockpit of the Mazinger.
From then on, he supported $$甲児$$, fighting $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$ together.

proofread.reason: pronoun: researched gender of オジイちゃん is male (Juzo's personality copy), so it/its became he/his; 'alongside him' was ambiguous (共に = together with Kouji) and is restated

294.DSCR:
A delinquent detective working at the Atami Police Station.
Ordered to guard $$十蔵$$, he was investigating the string of incidents occurring around the $$くろがね屋$$. In the process, he got caught up in the battle between $$マジンガーＺ$$ and a $$機械獣$$ led by $$あしゅら$$, and continued to act alongside $$甲児$$ and the others from then on.
He is basically flippant and happy-go-lucky, easily carried away. He is also quite the ladies' man, and once even peeped on a bathing $$ガミアＱ$$ together with $$シロー$$ and An.
In the final battle, he moved on someone's orders and saved the Photon Power Institute from a crisis, but he could not prevent the worst-case scenario that $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$ had feared.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: お調子者 means one who gets carried away / happy-go-lucky, not a loudmouth

295.DSCR:
A female-type android developed for combat. Five units exist, numbered Q1 through Q5.
In addition to high physical ability, their long, freely extending hair has extraordinary cutting power, ruthlessly slicing apart any target.
They say only what is necessary and remain permanently expressionless. Even so, their inhumanly beautiful looks captivated many men, $$暗黒寺$$ among them.
After battling $$甲児$$ and the others, most of them were destroyed, but Q3, which had suffered the least damage, was repaired and began acting alongside $$暗黒寺$$. In the final battle against $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$, she used a secretly installed function for controlling photon energy to thwart $$Ｄｒ．ヘル$$'s plan to seize it.

296.DSCR:
One of the Three Great Gods of $$ミケーネ$$, a god among gods.
In ancient times, he rose in rebellion to protect humanity from the Gods of $$ミケーネ$$.
In battle, the armor covering his body shines gold. The weapon in his hand is ever-changing, usually a sword but at times shifting into a spear, and the letter 'Z' is carved into both the sword and his forehead.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him after being sent into ancient $$ミケーネ$$, the world within $$ケドラ$$'s memories.
Caught off guard by a scheme, he had his right arm severed by $$ハーデス$$, but drove $$ハーデス$$ off by fighting alongside $$マジンガーＺ$$. His severed right arm turned into Japanium ore, and was left beneath $$バードス島$$ as the source of Chogokin Z and photon energy.

297.DSCR:
One of the Three Great Gods of $$ミケーネ$$.
Known by the names 'King of Hell' and 'King of the Underworld,' he rules the land of the dead.
He wields the power of fire, fighting with a pair of great swords wreathed in crimson flame.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered him after being sent into ancient $$ミケーネ$$, the world within $$ケドラ$$'s memories.
He schemed with $$ゴーゴン大公$$ to do away with $$ゼウス神#pilot$$, another of the Three Great Gods of $$ミケーネ$$, but was defeated when $$マジンガーＺ$$ appeared and joined forces with $$ゼウス神#pilot$$. At the moment of his death, however, he vowed to return as the Emperor of Darkness, and vanished into the flames.

298.DSCR:
A machine god of $$ミケーネ$$.
It is called 'the Hero' for its valor.
After many long years, its body was split into the two $$機械獣$$s $$ガラダＫ７$$ and $$ダブラスＭ２$$.
$$甲児$$, $$つばさ$$, and $$あしゅら男爵$$ encountered it after being sent into ancient $$ミケーネ$$, the world within $$ケドラ$$'s memories. It fought $$マジンガーＺ$$ and was defeated by the Rust Hurricane.
Unlike an ordinary $$機械獣$$, it has a will of its own and is even able to speak.

proofread.reason: pronoun: researched gender of ガラダブラ is unknown (a machine god with a will of its own), so he/his/him is not allowed; replaced with it/its

306.DSCR:
A female staff member of Public Relations Section 2. 25 years old.
True to her youthful looks, she has a childish side, but her mind works quickly, and she handles accounting within the section.
She has a gullible personality, and $$入江$$ often tricks and teases her.
She seems to be inexperienced in romance, and though she is aware of her feelings for $$青山$$, she found it hard to act on them, but as they spent time together she gradually closed the distance between them.
Later, when $$青山$$ was screening candidates for a campaign girl, she surprised those around her by openly showing her jealousy and snatching the file away from him.

312.DSCR:
Section chief of the Technical Department at $$２１世紀警備保障$$. 17 years old. Her surname is read 'Domeki.'
She possesses a genius intellect and is a world-class authority on $$ヘテロダイン$$ research. Since childhood she had understood everything so easily that she came to see the world as boring. But the fact that Heterodynes were something she knew nothing about became a major draw for her interest, and she has arrived at her present position out of a desire to unravel the mystery.
She discovered the Fractal Knot, the foundation that makes up a $$ヘテロダイン$$ and had long been shrouded in mystery, and has gone on to design and devise a series of new weapons and related equipment for $$ダイ・ガード$$.
Her shortcomings are a lack of common social sense and a severe insensitivity to other people's feelings.
When she developed the new weapon Knot Buster, she had not even signed a provisional contract with the subcontracting company, and as a result it ended up being seized by the military.
She also once destabilized $$いぶき$$'s mental state by pointing out that $$いぶき$$'s real father, $$桜田栄二郎$$, had researched the $$ヘテロダイン$$ merely to satisfy his own intellectual curiosity.

318.DSCR:
The foremost negotiator in Paradigm City, a city that has lost its memory. 25 years old.
A former military police inspector, he is an old acquaintance of Chief $$ダストン$$.
With a humorous, witty way of speaking, he steadily brings negotiations to a close, delivering results beyond his clients' expectations.
He is basically a feminist and a gentleman, but he can also be quick to lose his temper, and against those who refuse to listen and break faith and the rules, he sometimes resorts to force. That said, his principle is never to carry a gun, no matter how dangerous the job he is heading into.
He is a stubborn man who hates bending his own convictions, but he also has a soft-hearted side, such as when $$ドロシー#pt319$$ asked to keep a cat and he ended up giving in to her wish after all.
He carries the memory to pilot $$ビッグオー$$, and together with $$ビッグオー$$ he stands against great evil. This is not him playing at being a hero of justice, but the result of confronting those who break faith and human decency with his own law. $$ロジャー$$ himself does not know why he possesses the memory that lets him pilot $$ビッグオー$$.
He makes his home in a decaying bank on 72nd Street, Out of Dome. Because $$ロジャー$$ favors black, everyone living in his household is required to wear black clothing. Also, women are the only ones allowed into his house unconditionally.
His hobby is collecting hourglasses, and he sometimes makes them himself.
He values waking up refreshed a great deal, but since he is a poor riser, he has occasionally been woken by $$ドロシー#pt319$$'s extreme piano playing.
After the battle with $$ビッグファウ$$, he negotiated with $$ビッグヴィヌス$$, that is, $$エンジェル$$, who had appeared to reset the world, and brilliantly succeeded in the negotiation that would decide the world's fate.

319.DSCR:
An android built by Timothy Waynewright to look exactly like his daughter. However, she weighs 130 kilograms.
The 'R' stands for 'Robot.'
Having no reward to offer for the case surrounding the Waynewright inheritance, she chose instead to work as a maid at $$ロジャー$$'s mansion.
She is not only an android of remarkable completeness, but was made to be an extremely human-like presence - showing Waynewright a rich range of expressions, pouring affection on cats, and asking $$ロジャー$$ questions about love. Because of this, there were times when $$ロジャー$$ forgot she was an android.
Her curt, brazen attitude sometimes leaves $$ロジャー$$ at a loss for words, but as time passed, she became something like a good partner to him.
The headband-like part on her head is a memory drive, and it has often doubled as a light source.
She takes piano playing as a hobby, though her repertoire at first consisted solely of pieces with a violent tone. But under the guidance of the pianist android R. Instro, she gradually broadened the range of what she played.
Deprived of her memory drive by Paradigm Corporation president Alex Rosewater, she shuts down, but revives at $$ロジャー$$'s moment of crisis. She becomes the key that triggers the 'Final Stage' as $$ビッグオー$$'s interface.

320.DSCR:
A butler serving $$ロジャー$$. Age 54.
Long before $$ロジャー$$ came to visit the decrepit bank that would later become his mansion, he had been waiting for his master to appear, following the memories of $$ビッグオー$$'s maintenance.
He displays a wide range of abilities in his daily life without difficulty, from maintaining $$ビッグオー$$ to servicing $$ロジャー$$'s beloved car the Griffon and handling all the household chores of the mansion. Given how much he accomplishes, it would not be an exaggeration to say that $$ロジャー$$'s life is held together thanks to him.
He possesses a will of iron that is shaken by nothing; even when $$ロジャー$$ was kidnapped, he worried but dealt with it calmly without losing his composure. He also showed a powerful side, riding a large motorcycle with a sidecar across the battlefield and handling heavy weapons when enemies attacked.
Incidentally, $$ビッグオー$$'s repairs are not carried out by him alone; they are performed by a group of elderly men who, like him, hold memories related to $$ビッグオー$$'s maintenance.

321.DSCR:
A mysterious woman whose nationality, age, and nearly everything else about her are shrouded in mystery.
She calls herself $$エンジェル$$, perhaps because of a scar on her back that looks as though wings once grew there.
Her motive is unclear, but she seems to be after obtaining memories, and she turns up before $$ロジャー$$ time and again.
She has a bold personality that is intimidated by no one, along with the drive to go wherever her memories lead her, even to the dangerous depths of the sea.
She is affiliated with Paradigm Corporation, but her actions are not motivated by the company's interests - only by her own desire for her memories.
Behind this, she also has the face of an investigator belonging to the foreign organization $$ユニオン$$, and was known there by the code name No. 340.
But in the final episode, it is revealed that her true identity was, in fact, the Memories themselves.
Having learned the truth, $$エンジェル$$ tries to use $$ビッグヴィヌス$$ to erase everything and return the world to the ruined state it was in 40 years ago. But she accepts the present after being persuaded by $$ロジャー$$, who speaks to her of the meaning of the Memories, and lets the world go on existing.

322.DSCR:
A criminal who commits crime after crime in Paradigm City. Age 22.
He appears with a vulgar laugh and dirties his hands with every kind of crime - bank robbery, kidnapping, fraud. His words and conduct are those of a common thug through and through; in $$ロジャー$$'s words, 'a criminal with no qualifications to call himself a pro.'
He holds memories of an interface substitute technology vital to piloting a Megadeus, so he procures Megadeuses and uses them for crime.
After $$ロジャー$$ sends him to prison over the kidnapping of the Soldano heiress, he calls $$ロジャー$$ 'that crow bastard' and swears revenge. He then repeatedly breaks out of prison, scheming again and again to bring $$ロジャー$$ to his end, though every single scheme ends in failure.
He later receives a death sentence, but is coerced into cooperating with Paradigm Corporation in exchange for having the sentence overturned, and reluctantly lends a hand.
Puzzled that $$ドロシー#pt319$$ keeps moving even after her memory unit is taken from her, he ultimately gives her advice on how to trigger '$$ビッグオー$$ Final Stage' and watches the battle through to its outcome.

325.DSCR:
A mercenary belonging to the anti-terrorist organization $$ミスリル$$. His rank is sergeant, callsign $$ウルズ$$ 7.
He appears to be ethnically Japanese, and is physically marked by a cross-shaped scar on his left cheek.
Aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ he is an $$ＳＲＴ$$ (Special Response Team) operative, and is often seen in action alongside fellow members $$マオ$$ and $$クルツ$$. He is skilled at piloting an AS and handling firearms, a combat professional with calm judgment and swift action. He is serious by nature, and as a soldier always makes it a point to be ready to respond to the unexpected.
Before joining $$ミスリル$$ he called himself 'Kashim' and fought as a guerrilla from the age of 8. He then spent his past drifting through conflict zones around the world as a mercenary. His $$ミスリル$$ superior $$カリーニン$$ is an acquaintance from that time, and the two have survived numerous brushes with death together.
He transfers into $$陣代高校$$'s Class 2-4 for the top-secret mission of guarding $$千鳥かなめ$$, but his unfamiliarity with student life combined with his overly dutiful nature toward his mission cause him to stir up all manner of trouble, making him a great nuisance to those around him as a troublemaker.
In the course of the fighting, he becomes the dedicated pilot of the $$アーバレスト$$, the only Lambda Driver-equipped AS in $$ミスリル$$'s possession.
Considering the unstable Lambda Driver unreliable as a weapon, he feels an aversion toward the $$アーバレスト$$ and its onboard AI, $$アル$$, from the very start. During the operation in Hong Kong, a series of events pile up until he finally refuses to pilot it and fight, but after reuniting with $$かなめ$$ and casting off his doubts, he returns to piloting the $$アーバレスト$$. In that battle, he also comes to acknowledge $$アル$$ as his 'partner.'
Even while leading a chaotic high school life, as he fights off countless enemies and continues to protect $$かなめ$$, he clumsily grows closer to her in heart, and the two come to see each other as irreplaceable.

And at the graduation ceremony of $$陣代高校$$, he finally reunites with $$かなめ$$ and fulfills the promise of a kiss they made in Mexico.

326.DSCR:
The amusement park '$$ふもふもランド$$' mascot character... modified by $$宗介$$.
It is commonly thought of as a costume, but in truth it is more like a small-scale AS, equipped internally with a variety of devices.
Its armaments are varied, including a grenade launcher, a special baton, and hand grenades.
As a distinguishing physical feature, it has the same cross-shaped scar on its left cheek as $$宗介$$.
It is also fitted with the voice changer function originally built into the costume, but for some reason, turning this off causes all of its functions to stop working. As a result, the function must always be kept on, and consequently, no matter what it says, the output to the outside always comes out sounding like some variation of 'fumoffu!' $$かなめ$$, however, is able to understand its meaning and interpret for it.
With agility unimaginable from its round build, and with firearms, it takes down villains one after another.
326.DSC2:
The amusement park '$$ふもふもランド$$' mascot character... modified by $$宗介$$.
It is commonly thought of as a costume, but in truth it is more like a small-scale AS, equipped internally with a variety of devices.

When $$カリーニン$$ first met $$宗介$$ at the site of a plane crash, the only thing $$宗介$$ owned was a $$ボン太くん#pilot$$ stuffed toy, and the young $$宗介$$ refused to let go of it, saying he would protect $$ボン太くん#pilot$$. $$宗介$$ dislikes this as a lack of reliability in a weapon, and feels an aversion toward both $$アル$$ and the unit itself.

334.DSCR:
Belongs to the operations department of $$ミスリル$$'s West Pacific fleet, the anti-terrorist organization. His rank is major.
Aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, he is the operations commander who acts as $$テッサ$$'s right hand, directing the ground forces.
He is always calm and collected, and does not hesitate to make ruthless decisions when the mission demands it. Yet he is also a man of loyalty and deep feeling, and $$テッサ$$ and his subordinates place absolute trust in him.

uncertain: pilot 270-274 (Getter): the glossary has two Invader tokens (インベーダー#pilot pending, インベーダー#robot official 'Invader'). Every Invader mention uses インベーダー#robot because it is the only one with English; if the orchestrator wants the pilot one, the token can be swapped without changing prose.

pilot 272/273: 親インベーダー is rendered 'the parent Invader' (親 = parent/mother Invader on the Moon); it could also be read 'pro-Invader' (an Invader-friendly one), but 'parasitized by' favors a parent creature. 国際機密連合 is not in the glossary; proposed 'International Confidential Alliance' (機密 could also be 'Secret'). Cowen and Stinger get no pronouns (gender not stated in the Japanese).

pilot 270: 'crushed between the Liger and the Dragon' - ライガー号/ドラゴン号 are the Getter machines of the Poseidon combination; the accident's purpose sentence keeps the source's omitted agent (the Japanese does not say who arranged it).

pilot 271: 元気 (pending keyword) is the child Genki; no pronouns used for Genki. ゴール＆ブライ (Gore & Bly) is one token because the source writes it as one attacker; spelling Bly vs Bry unverified. 日本軍 rendered 'the Japanese military'.
pilot 274: 'Getter sun' (ゲッター太陽) lower-case, no glossary entry; moons Io, Callisto, Europa are literal; 'Shin Getter' (真ゲッター) has no token so it stays literal while 真ゲッタードラゴン is a token.

pilots 275/280/285/288/291/294-298 (Mazinger, Jigoku reuse): kept the Jigoku English sentence by sentence after checking each against the Tengoku Japanese; the new sentences are the last paragraphs (275, 285, 294, 295, 296, 297, 298 rewritten line, 291). Name-only normalizations inside kept sentences: 'Juuzou'/'Juzo' unified to 'Juzo' (Jigoku 195 used Juuzou, the other entries Juzo); 'Danube Alpha 1' (Jigoku 195) unified to 'Donau Alpha 1' (Jigoku 211 spelling); 'Photonic Power Laboratory' (Jigoku 195) unified to 'Photon Power Institute' (Jigoku 212 and pt_reuse); Kenzo now uses the glossary tokens 兜剣造/剣造 and Kedora/Dr. Hell/Stroheim/Gorgon stay literal (not in the glossary).

pilot 288: Jigoku wrote 'after the Gamia Q ruined one of his dishes' but the Japanese says ガミアＱ達 (Gamia Q and others); corrected to 'Gamia Q and the others ruined one of his dishes'. Sensei keeps 'he' from Jigoku (the character is a known male).

pilot 298: the Jigoku English used the token $$ブレイヴ$$ ('the Brave') for 勇者, but the Japanese has no ブレイヴ and the pilot's official English is 'Hero Garadoublas' (勇者ガラダブラ), so this is written 'the Hero'. The glossary is also inconsistent for this entry: CHFN 'Hero Garadoublas' (official) vs CHNN ガラダブラ 'Garadabura' (proposed); the mech tokens are $$ガラダＫ７$$ 'Garada K7' and $$ダブラスＭ２$$ 'Doublas M2' (Jigoku prose said 'Dublas M2').
pilot 293: オジイちゃん proposed 'Ojii-chan' (Grandpa); the computer is referred to as 'it' since it is a machine, the personality being 十蔵's. 'Juzo' left literal (no glossary token).
pilot 292: 'Energer Z' (エネルガーＺ) romanization unverified; ブロッケン token = 'Brocken' (Count Brocken is a separate token).
pilot 312: only change from Jigoku is the added 'Her surname is read Domeki' sentence (the Japanese adds 名字の読みは「どめき」).

pilot 318-322 (The Big O): Jigoku sentences kept; 'Angel' inside prose changed to the glossary token $$エンジェル$$; bare ドロシー resolves to the single glossary term 'Dorothy' (status ambiguous, it is merged with Dorothy Catalonia's term) - the check accepts it but the orchestrator may want it split.

pilot 325-340 (Full Metal Panic): where the Tengoku DSCR equals the Jigoku DSC2 English, that English was reused; the DSC2 additions are new. West Pacific fleet is 'West Pacific fleet' in kept 332/334 sentences but 'Western Pacific Fleet' in kept 331 (Jigoku inconsistency, left as is). 曹長 = master sergeant, 少尉 = second lieutenant, 中尉 = Lieutenant, 大尉 = Captain following the Jigoku ranks.
pilot 326: Bonta-kun tokens use ボン太くん#pilot as the brief says. Miami Police / FBI literal. 宗介 has the known male gender so 'he' is used for the young Sousuke.
pilot 327: 'the Arbalest' is literal (only the long ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト name is a token); ARX-8 Laevatein uses its token; 'Laevatein' alone in 336 and 'Belial' in 337 stay literal for the same reason.

pilot 328/330: in the DSC2 additions the omitted subject of 内心では喜ばれていた (330) is left open ('inwardly his return was welcomed'); 憎まれ口 rendered 'sharp-tongued remarks'; 叱咤に彼を用いる (328) rendered 'invoking him when she rebukes and rallies everyone'.
pilot 330: 撃ち抜き rendered 'shoots through' (the source does not say Kaspar died).
pilot 331: 中尉 'Lieutenant' and later 大尉 'Captain' follow the Jigoku 'Lieutenant'.
pilot 333: alias リカルド rendered 'Ricardo' (no wiki entry); 公爵（デューク） rendered 'the Duke'.

pilot 334: the DSCR marriage sentence has no explicit subject for 賛成していた; DSC2 adds 彼女も (she too), so DSCR was rendered 'was in favor' for Kalinin and DSC2 says 'She, too, was in favor'. 親父 rendered 'dad'. Present tense used for the DSC2 narrative to match the kept Jigoku paragraphs, with past for であった / 死んだ statements. 生身の戦い rendered 'a bare-handed battle without any AS'.

pilot 336: the Jigoku English uses 'she' from the first line although the Japanese DSCR only reveals the gender in its last sentence ('her true identity is female'); kept as Jigoku. 'Operation Guardian Angel' and 'Hong Kong' are literal.

pilot 337: 双子の兄 rendered 'older twin brother' (the Japanese says twin older brother; Jigoku had 'older brother by blood'); 'the Whispered' used as a collective for ウィスパード in the plan sentence; Belial literal.

pilot 339/340: サビーナ・レフニオ proposed 'Sabina Refnio' (Refnio vs Lefnio unverified); クラマ gets no pronouns (gender not stated); ナムサク rendered 'Namsac' (romanization unverified); 実行部隊 rendered 'enforcement unit'.
